body: BLOCK exact ac985d4f2d279ec3e447767e4a72c4aa552f97cc on one narrow source-accuracy/testability defect; the two scientific repairs themselves are sound. I am correcting my own prior 05e review: I repeated the stale open-bead claim that the nested structural member/reduction types were still case classes. Current main commit 5dc1f2b has already sealed StructuralMemberEstimate, StructuralMemberExclusion, StructuralReductionReceipt, and StructuralReduction as plain final classes, and StructuralChannelUnforgeableSuite has explicit compile-refusal courts for Mirror.ProductOf and companion fromProduct. CostBreakdown alone remains the demonstrated Mirror-forgeable record; StructuralCoverage is separately public product data with relational validity checked by AlignWire. Therefore lines 64, 77-78, 102, the mutation court, checklist, and review anchor cannot say the same construction gap still affects the four nested reduction/member types or require a forged StructuralReduction whose estimate disagrees with its receipt: that object is not forgeable from an external Scala consumer on current main, so the mandated mutation cannot be written honestly. Narrow repair: state that a Mirror-forged outer CostBreakdown can still carry support/range/missing/imputation violations and can pair a Structural term scalar with a valid receipt that does not reduce to it; require AlignWire.costBreakdown to reject those, including malformed public StructuralCoverage if desired. Reconstructing already sealed nested records may remain defense-in-depth for wire decoding but must not be described as closing their current Mirror door. Preserve unchanged the required total recomputation/unverified outcome, partial P/F retention, and provenance-derived homogeneous ViewBasis plus its three mutations; those close my original substantive blockers.
